builds.caption: a real run of assay on a live page
builds.tagline: A CLI that opens your web page in a real browser, finds every control, and tells you what broke.
builds.home_tagline: A Deterministic CLI that opens your web page in a real browser, finds every control, and tells you what broke. No LLM, no tests to write.
features: Discovers every control the page renders and works out a test plan from it
Drives clicks, typing and navigation in a real chromium, not a mock, and tells you what broke
Fully deterministic, with a median run time of 14s
Ships with 15 wrappers that plug it into agentic coding harnesses as skills and plugins
